goal: Speed up block propagation by prefilling missing compact block transactions within TCP window limits
Eliminate round-trips to retrieve missing transactions, lowering stale block and orphan risks network-wide
agreement: Broad support for the concept and backwards compatibility (0xB10C, josibake, johnnyasantoss)
Verified on live nodes with telemetry confirming higher immediate reconstruction (m4ycon)
Verified against compact block unit and functional test suites (s00ly)
Past objections on use-after-free, locking, and unnecessary TCP syscalls were resolved (andrewtoth)

why: P2 because it cuts block propagation delays by avoiding extra application round-trips
Immediate compact block reconstruction rose from 56.9% to 89.7% in live telemetry
Reduces orphan risk and stale block rates across the entire network
